concerns.text: ‘Non-English and gibberish text is filtered out’ lacks a measurable definition of what constitutes ‘gibberish’ and what confidence threshold is used for language detection, making the criterion untestable.

‘filter_applied metadata contributes to the control proxy score’ does not specify how the contribution is quantified (e.g., weighting, aggregation), so the success of this requirement cannot be verified.

‘timestamp_regularity is calculated per user’ assumes the source dataset contains a timestamp field per post; the chosen HuggingFace dataset (`cardiffnlp/tweet_sentiment_extraction`) does not provide timestamps or user IDs, rendering the required input unreachable.

‘The pipeline must handle empty datasets and download failures gracefully’ does not define what ‘gracefully’ means (e.g., specific exit codes, log messages, retry policy), so the behavior cannot be objectively measured.

The conditional clause ‘If this threshold cannot be met … the dataset size must be reduced or the model architecture simplified’ lacks a concrete decision rule or measurable trigger, making it ambiguous how to verify compliance.
